_note: The shot list is data, not code. A prompt that lives in a source file can be read, argued with, and re-rendered; one baked into a driver cannot. frames must be 4n+1 — that is Wan's temporal VAE, which compresses four frames into one latent step and needs the odd frame to close the sequence.

model.hardware_note: 6.1 GB VRAM, encoder pinned to CPU, weights streamed from disk

negative_default: worst quality, inconsistent motion, blurry, jittery, distorted, static image, watermark, text, subtitles

shots.prompt: slow tracking shot following a lone figure walking across a rain-soaked rooftop at night, neon signs reflecting in the wet concrete, city haze, distant towers, cinematic anamorphic look, shallow depth of field
empty grand hall at blue hour, tall windows, dust in the shafts of light, slow dolly forward down the centre aisle, symmetrical composition, film still
